info.title: UniCloud Portal API
info.summary: Single sign-on, the directory and the staging tools for UniCloud modules.
info.description:
The APIs a UniCloud module calls. The OpenID Connect browser flow (`/oauth2/authorize`, `/connect/logout`) is described by the discovery document and by [docs/sso.md](https://github.com/Alex-Tsvetanov/unicloud-portal/blob/main/docs/sso.md); every OIDC library reads it.

**Try it out:** register a module with the directory grant on the staging page (`/staging`), press **Authorize**, choose `directoryToken` and enter the client id and secret. Swagger UI then gets a client-credentials token for you.

Unknown values mean no access: `role` and `permissions` may gain new values. Treat a value you do not know as no access.

post.summary: Exchange a code, or get a directory token
post.description:
Client authentication is HTTP Basic only (`client_secret_basic`).

- `authorization_code`: exchanges the code from the callback. The code works once and for 60 seconds. A second exchange fails and revokes what the first one issued.
- `client_credentials`: a token for the directory API. The module must hold the `directory` grant.
